videos.title: The Agent Behind the Curtain: Building the Oz Cloud Agent Platform — Safia Abdalla, Warp
videos.summary: AI coding has outgrown single prompts and local laptops, demanding dedicated cloud platforms that coordinate specialized agent swarms behind the scenes. In this talk, Warp's Safia Abdalla breaks down how they architected 'Oz'—their cloud agent platform—to seamlessly handle sandboxing, multi-harness orchestration, and automated PR lifecycles while shielding developers from infrastructure complexity. Watch this if you want a concrete, battle-tested blueprint for turning AI agents into a scalable, real-world software workshop.

timestamps.topic: Why Real Engineering Requires Multi-Agent Orchestration Beyond a Single Prompt
Automating the Open Source SDLC Loop with Autonomous Review Agents
From 'Software Factory' to 'Software Workshop': Designing Systems for Human-Centric Craft

videos.title: Agent Frameworks Considered Harmful — Rémi Louf, .txt
videos.summary: Most AI agent frameworks make building autonomous systems needlessly fragile by burying logic in complex graph code instead of treating agents like standard background operating system processes. In this talk, dottxt CEO Rémi Louf shares how replacing heavy agent libraries with an event-driven, content-addressed kernel architecture makes agents auditable, reproducible, and truly reliable. If you are struggling with flaky agent orchestration or debugging nightmare pipelines, this presentation provides the exact blueprint for fixing your agent infrastructure.

timestamps.topic: Why coding agents in code is harmful vs. declarative definitions
Event-driven orchestration: Eliminating graph complexity
Building content-addressed prompts and auditable AI execution

videos.title: What To Do With Your Life
videos.summary: Asking yourself what to do with your life is too vague to be useful—real clarity only comes when you break life into specific domains and define what you strictly do not want just as clearly as what you desire. This video breaks down an actionable, 3-step framework combining unconstrained dream mapping and the famous 5-Year Odyssey Plan to turn abstract existential dread into a tangible direction. If you feel stuck at a career or personal crossroads, this step-by-step roadmap will give you the practical clarity you need to move forward with confidence.

timestamps.topic: Step 1: Mapping Life Areas and Defining What You Want
Step 2: Unconstrained Dream Mapping (Have, Do, Learn, Experience)
